name: task-github
description: GitHub adapter for task-worker Issue Trees, PR transport, externally owned review handoffs, and gated closeout.

interface.shortDescription: Project task-worker graphs into GitHub delivery workflows.
interface.longDescription: Uses a compatible task-worker as the provider-neutral execution engine, projects complete work graphs to GitHub Issue trees, and owns labels, pull requests, checks, merge, and closeout. Opaque external review ownership preserves PR transport while suppressing only duplicate reviewer dispatch.
defaultPrompt: Use $init to create or validate local task-github provider configuration without GitHub mutation.
Use $define to project a task-worker definition into a linked GitHub Issue tree.
Use $orchestrate only for worker dispatch; manual dispatch must never create local worker runs.
